notes: `עַל יַד` is fused under rule 30, the one English word *beside* carrying both morphemes and headed on the construct noun; the construction-supplied copula joining it does not defeat the one-rendering condition (rules 20, 49).
Both coordinated recta are rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted: each article takes the *the* standing before its own word and `רוּחַ` takes a supplied one (rule 29).
